notes: BUU Legacy 1.3.5 - Stop/lifecycle fixes: clean stop now finishes the current row then halts, added a Force-stop button, and a 90s force-kill backstop so Stop never hangs. Checkpoint integrity: atomic writes that can no longer be clobbered by a locked read, protecting long-run resume. Incognito + leaner headless launch for lower resource use. This is the last single-process build and serves as the stable fallback.
